text:
release-coordinator: Quick heads-up — we plan to run a tiered canary for query-optimizer v2.1 tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Need a deploy owner, smoke owner, and rollback standby. High-level plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~120m. Can someone take deploy and confirm smoke checks + rollback readiness? :eyes:

neha_pm: I'm owning cohort selection. Proposed cohorts below — please flag if any region/segment concerns. I'll update the release dashboard once owner confirmed.
```
cohort plan:
- step1: 0.5% random traffic (US)
- step2: 5% (US + EU web clients)
- step3: 25% (cross-region gradual)
- step4: 100% (global)
ramp windows: 10m stabilization between steps, full ramp target within 120m
```

tom_infra: I can run the deploy and will be on-call for the rollout window. Deploy steps I will use: build -> push image tag `qo-2.1-canary-<ts>` -> kick canary job. Will post the exact kubectl/job command before start. :rocket:

maria_prod: I'll take smoke ownership. My smoke checklist: health endpoint, p50/p95 latency, error-rate by endpoint, KV cache hit-rate, and a small synthetic trace. Will run smoke at t+5 and t+15 after each ramp. Put a link to the smoke runbook? https://runbooks/internal/smoke-query-optimizer v2 :thumbsup:

sam_sre: I'll standby for rollback. Rollback playbook to follow is `/playbooks/rollback-query-optimizer`. Immediate rollback triggers I care about: >0.5% absolute error-rate increase sustained for 5m, p95 latency jump >400ms from baseline, or any user-facing 5xx spike. If we need to rollback I'll coordinate the traffic shift back and open an incident if >30m.

release-coordinator: Good — tom and maria confirmed, Sam standby. Tom, add the deploy job and calendar invite please. Maria, paste the smoke checklist link into this thread when ready. I'll create the canary watch dashboard and add alert thresholds from Sam's notes.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: job-id `canary-1718507777-qo2.1`. Calendar invite sent to tom_infra, maria_prod, sam_sre, neha_pm.

tom_infra: Deploy command I'll run (preview):
```bash
kubectl set image deploy/query-optimizer query-optimizer=ghcr.io/redwood/qo:qo-2.1-canary-1718507777 -n production-canary
# then trigger canary controller: /scripts/canary-ramp --job canary-1718507777 --steps "0.5,5,25,100" --wait 600
```
I'll ping here at start + at each ramp.

maria_prod: Smoke runbook posted: https://runbooks/internal/smoke-query-optimizer-v2 — I'll paste results back in this thread. My minimal smoke asserts:
- latency: p95 < baseline + 200ms
- errors: 5xx rate <= baseline + 0.5%
- correctness quick-check: 10 sample queries

sam_sre: Also add a canary traffic split safeguard: if control vs canary divergence exceeds threshold auto-pause (canary controller supports it). I recommend enabling `auto_pause_on_diverge=true` for this run.

neha_pm: One more ask: please hold off on changing routing rules or related infra during the window (22:00–00:30 UTC). I'll post a small note to product leads.

release-coordinator: Sounds good. Final checklist before start: deploy owner (tom_infra) ✅, smoke (maria_prod) ✅, rollback standby (sam_sre) ✅, cohorts (neha_pm) ✅. Anything else? Otherwise we proceed with the plan tomorrow 22:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

maria_prod: Nothing else from my side. I'll post smoke template outputs into this thread (short summary + artifact link).

tom_infra: Copy. Will push at 22:00 UTC and post progress updates here. If anyone needs to opt-out a target cohort, ping me ASAP before 21:30.

release-coordinator: Thanks everyone — will mark the roll plan as green and lock the window. If anything changes, update here so we have an audit trail.

(End of thread)
